## Verdict

The recorded refutation target does not survive.

Inventory at `7234a9dd9231cc64a094a16f44c03080a713427e` before findings: `evaluateMergePathArm` (`packages/core/src/pr-watch/main.ts`) takes a caller boolean `livePhaseCorrectWait`; CLI `verify:review-monitor` (`packages/cli/src/verify-review-monitor.ts`) sets that boolean from `--live-wait` plus Tier-1 lease presence (`result.monitorRecord !== null`); gate `evaluateReviewMonitorGate` (`packages/core/src/review-monitor/verify.ts`) treats an unexpired sticky `<!-- deft:review-owner -->` as ready and also computes `heartbeatActive` via `hasActivePollingHeartbeat` without feeding it into merge-path arm; lease end is explicit `review-monitor:release` / `ended_at` (`packages/core/src/review-monitor/record.ts`, `lease-comment.ts`); neighboring liveness seams already exist as `hasActivePollingHeartbeat` and `verify:subagent-alive`. Help text for `--live-wait` literally says "Attest".

## --live-wait plus lease is attestation, not a still-running wait
blocks-the-design
Evidence: At the dispatch SHA, `liveBound = args.liveWait && (!isTier1(result.tier) || leaseEvidence)` with `leaseEvidence = result.monitorRecord !== null`; `evaluateMergePathArm` then arms on that boolean alone. Unit tests arm Tier-3 on bare `--live-wait` with no lease, and arm Tier-1 `--live-wait` once a lease record is present. `heartbeatActive` is returned on the gate result and ignored by the arm path. Sticky lease expiry defaults to thirty minutes (`DEFAULT_STALE_MINUTES`); release is a separate verb, not a wait-exit hook.
Failure mode: Approach 1 / `pr:watch` exits while the sticky lease remains; a later `--merge-path-arm --live-wait` probe still reports armed. Merge-path ownership stands down with no phase-correct waiter; CLEAN can arrive with nobody left to merge or finish option-C. Shared GitHub lease state plus a caller-supplied flag is injectable across agents and sessions.
Disposition: Reject the target premise that lease evidence plus `--live-wait` / `--merge-path-arm` is sufficient still-running proof. A bindable successor must fail closed unless process-liveness (or equivalent host-visible wait identity that cannot outlive the process) is evidenced, or the lease auto-clears when the wait exits. Prefer wiring existing heartbeat / `verify:subagent-alive` seams over inventing a third poller.

## Leftover durable-wait complete on that attestation alone overclaims
blocks-the-design
Evidence: Greptile P1 on leftover PR #5019 (comment 5821732519) states the completed xBRIEF marks durable-live-wait complete from #5018 while that check accepts caller `--live-wait` without proving the wait process remains. Issue #5020 body and Stop 1 P2 record the same overclaim class. Product docs at this SHA still name the probe as the machine observer for "still-running" wait (`content/scm/github.md`, review-cycle / swarm / preamble).
Failure mode: Leftover twins stamp the durable-wait clause complete from armed-looking attestation after #5018, while the dogfood hole (wait dead, lease sticky, probe green) remains open.
Disposition: The target's second conjunct fails with the first. Bind must keep leftover / completed-brief wording from claiming that clause complete on lease+flag attestation alone until a still-running proof (or auto-clear) lands.

## Lease TTL is not a substitute still-running proof
footnote
Evidence: `DEFAULT_STALE_MINUTES = 30` and `isPassMarkerActive` / expires_at gates abandon stale leases on read; release still requires an explicit edit. A wait can exit in seconds while the lease stays active for the full TTL window. Greptile's #5019 finding fires without waiting out that window.
Failure mode: Treating TTL expiry as process-liveness would leave a multi-minute false-armed window and would not discharge P1/P2 as filed.
Disposition: Does not rescue the target. TTL remains abandonment hygiene, not wait liveness.

## Road-not-taken

Steelmanning the target: #5018 already refuses lease-only unarmed stand-down, and Tier-1 binds `--live-wait` to lease evidence so a bare flag cannot arm alone. That closes the pure Path-B promise hole. It still leaves the dead-wait-plus-sticky-lease window, which is exactly Stop 1 P1. Flip condition for the target: a deterministic control that the wait process (or heartbeat identity bound to that wait) is alive at probe time, or that the lease cannot remain active after the wait exits.

## Verdict

Successor lean 5822199029 Bound remedy covers Stop 1 pains P1 and P2 as asserted. Re-verified anchors at `7234a9dd9231cc64a094a16f44c03080a713427e` match critic 5822187680: CLI `liveBound = args.liveWait && (!isTier1(result.tier) || leaseEvidence)` with `leaseEvidence = result.monitorRecord !== null`; `evaluateMergePathArm` arms on that boolean alone; `heartbeatActive` / `hasActivePollingHeartbeat` are computed on the gate and unused by the arm path; lease end is explicit `review-monitor:release` / `ended_at`, not wait-exit; `DEFAULT_STALE_MINUTES = 30`; help text for `--live-wait` still says "Attest". Inventory of neighboring seams (`hasActivePollingHeartbeat`, `verify:subagent-alive`) is present at this SHA.

No `blocks-the-design` findings on the asserted cites.

## Preferred heartbeat seam must actually observe the P1 wait class
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `hasActivePollingHeartbeat` only returns true for scratch records with `pr_number` match, no failures, non-stale, non-terminal, and `phase` in `polling|starting`. Approach 1 / blocking `pr:watch` is the wait class named in P1; those waits do not automatically mint that scratch shape unless the host path already writes it. Bound remedy item 1 prefers those seams and also allows an equivalent host-visible wait identity that cannot outlive the process, or sticky-lease auto-clear on wait exit.
Failure mode: Implement wires gate arm to `heartbeatActive` while Approach 1 leaves never write polling heartbeats, so probes stay permanently unarmed, or implement keeps `--live-wait` caller attestation beside an empty heartbeat check and the dead-wait-plus-sticky-lease window remains.
Disposition: Lean can bind. Harvest already names equivalent identity and auto-clear alternatives. Implement must pick a proof that observes the P1 wait class (or clear the lease so presence cannot outlive the process); do not treat unused `heartbeatActive` as sufficient without that binding.

## Auto-clear timing is already constrained by "cannot outlive"
footnote
Evidence: Item 1's auto-clear alternative says lease presence cannot outlive the process; item 5 requires wait-exits-while-lease-sticky => arm fails or lease cleared. Synchronous clear-with-exit (or probe-time absence) is already implied.
Failure mode: A best-effort async clear after exit would reopen a short false-armed window.
Disposition: Census only. Item 5's test lock already forces the honest reading; no harvest change.

## Lease TTL remains abandonment hygiene
footnote
Evidence: `DEFAULT_STALE_MINUTES = 30`; `isLeaseExpired` / `ended_at` gates; release is a separate verb. Bound remedy item 4 keeps TTL outside wait-liveness. Agrees with critic 5822187680 footnote.
Failure mode: Treating TTL as P1 relief would leave a multi-minute false-armed window.
Disposition: Outside the take map; does not reopen P1/P2 coverage.

## Injection / swarm lens
Shared GitHub sticky lease plus a caller-supplied `--live-wait` flag is cross-agent injectable attestation at this SHA. Bound remedy items 1-2 replace that with process-bound evidence (or lease that cannot outlive the wait). No additional blocking residual under #480 for this local gate recut.

## Road-not-taken

Steelmanning a coverage miss: item 3's "Until item 1 lands" could be read as temporary prose without a durable leftover stamp gate. Flip condition: if item 5's leftover-wording test lock were absent, P2 would be soft policy only. Item 5 is present, so P2 stays covered as a bind conjunct with the product fail-closed path.

metadata.issueBody:
## Summary
Follow-up to #4882 / #5018: `verify:review-monitor --merge-path-arm --live-wait` is still an **attestation** bound to lease evidence on Tier 1. It does not prove a still-running phase-correct wait. A monitor can exit while the lease remains, and a later probe can look armed.

Greptile called this out on leftover PR #5019 when the completed xBRIEF overclaimed durable-wait completion.

## Parent
Child of https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4832 (tracker). Supersedes the remaining honesty gap after #4882.

## Desired outcome
Fail closed unless process-liveness (or equivalent) is evidenced, for example:
- Approach 1 / blocking `pr:watch` child still alive for this PR, or
- lease auto-clears when the wait exits, or
- another host-visible wait identity that cannot outlive the process.

Until then, leftover twins must not claim the durable-wait clause complete (disposition / wording).

## Dogfood
- Product: #5018
- Leftover honesty: #5019
- Prior blind poller: #5015 dogfood on #4832
